open_work: The two original X centres and source identities remain. New bodies move into the .32m exposed serving strip in front of the fitted drawer bank; original .48/.50m depths cannot fit that strip. Telephone base uses .216m depth; closed paper ledger uses .22m depth. Original hidden poses stay unchanged.

The phone has a closed body, seated feet, stem, hollow transmitter and hanging receiver, hook, cord and perforated blank rotary ring. The ledger is a closed stack with plain brown card covers and binding. No generated lettering or new material key.

Physical supports and sampled separations only. Telephone communication, readable ledger contents, dispensing, medicine/poison custody, continuous routes and independent utilities retain separate authority.
